content.text: In `agents` 0.23.0 and later, use the `this.dynamicAgents` API on your Agent. `subAgent()` became `this.dynamicAgents.get(ChildClass, id)`. The other methods map the same way: `hasSubAgent()` → `.has()`, `listSubAgents()` → `.list()`, `abortSubAgent()` → `.abort()`, `deleteSubAgent()` → `.delete()`. The old methods still work because they now call `this.dynamicAgents` internally, so nothing breaks yet. They're marked `@deprecated` in the installed `agents` 0.27.0 (`node_modules/agents/dist/agent-routing-Bhdbvf7s.d.ts:5817`), so new code should use `dynamicAgents`.
